title: Public-Records Jurisdiction
description: Canonical record of a single transparency-law jurisdiction. Every load-bearing fact is wrapped in a SourcedField with citation, source URL, and certainty so the corpus is auditable and the product never invents law.

schema_version.description: Semver of the schema this record conforms to.

level.description: Government level. v0 does not cover local government.

law.description: Identity of the controlling transparency statute.

acknowledgment_deadline.description: Time within which the agency must acknowledge receipt.

substantive_deadline.description: Time within which the agency must produce records or assert exemptions.

constructive_denial.description: What happens if the agency does not respond in time.

fees.description: Cost structure the requester may face.

fee_waiver.description: Conditions for fee waiver (public-interest, indigent, etc.).

submission.description: How a requester may file the request.

accepted_methods.description: Object whose value is an array of: 'mail' | 'email' | 'online_portal' | 'fax' | 'in_person' | 'phone'.

required_identification.description: Whether requester must provide ID, name, address, or citizenship.

agency_designation.description: How to identify the correct records custodian.

exemptions.description: Statutory grounds an agency may use to withhold records.

categories.description: Value is an array of {name, citation, summary} entries.

segregability_rule.description: Whether non-exempt portions must be released after redaction.

requester_eligibility.description: Who may file (any person, citizens only, residents, etc.). Critical for some states.

corpus_meta.description: Provenance for the record as a whole, independent of per-field provenance.

last_verified.description: ISO date the corpus maintainer last reviewed against authoritative source.

primary_source_url.description: Canonical .gov URL for the statute itself.

archived_source_url.description: Wayback Machine or equivalent snapshot of the primary source.

maintainers.description: Who owns review for this jurisdiction. Use agent ids or human handles.

blocks_field.description: JSON pointer to the field this question blocks.

open_questions.description: Unresolved interpretation questions escalated to legal review.

SourcedField.description: A single fact about the law, with mandatory provenance. Every value-bearing field in the corpus uses this shape so a downstream UI can always show its source.

value.description: The fact. Type varies by field; consumers should not rely on a single primitive type.

certainty.description: confirmed: directly stated in the statute. uncertain: requires interpretation but corpus maintainer is confident. needs_escalation: open legal question, do not surface to user without disclaimer.

citation.description: The specific section reference, e.g. '5 U.S.C. § 552(a)(6)(A)(i)'.

source_url.description: Direct link to the .gov source for this specific fact.

retrieved_on.description: When the maintainer last verified this specific source URL resolved to the cited content.

notes.description: Maintainer notes, including caveats, recent amendments, or interpretive considerations.
